Now I see something interesting. The `path_len` is initialized to `sizeof(path_value)` (128). After `asn1_decode`, `path_len` is updated to the actual length of the decoded path. Then `memcpy(path->value, path_value, path_len)` copies `path_len` bytes from `path_value` to `path->value`.

But `path->value` is `SC_MAX_PATH_SIZE` (128) bytes. So if `path_len` is <= 128, this is safe.
